Episode 797. Enemy Clan(1)
"Heuk, huk...!"
Somewhere deep underground, far away from the ancient Oterium.
The place where the three enemies who fled from Jin teleported to was the third city of the enemy clan, once called 'Patlock.'

The three who fell into the castle of Patlock twisted their bodies for a while, retching from the aftermath of teleportation. The enemy clan's 'Return Magic' naturally put a lot of strain on the body, and the three, weaker than ever, were vomiting blood.
"......Is everyone okay."
Shimart spoke, catching his breath.
"Yes... Shimart kin. We're safe."
"Damn, Makiram and Manta are gone as soon as we wake up...!"
Andollin and Ozen answered with gloomy voices.
It was because of Makiram and Manta, the catalysts for the return spell. There was no room to grieve for their comrades' sacrifice while they were fighting Jin.

Using comrades as catalysts for return magic was only for these moments. It was the enemy clan's rule that the weakest kin would sacrifice themselves when they needed to avoid annihilation, and there was no other life form to serve as a catalyst.

However, excluding Shimart, all of the five awakened enemy clans were second-level Martial Kings. There was no hierarchy difference, and it was hard to distinguish their combat strength, so Makiram and Manta simply stepped forward first.

"Don't cry, brother Ozen. It was the best choice since he cut off brother Makiram's arm. It's the same for brother Manta, who was right next to Jin. From now on, we just need to avenge our two brothers."

Shimart spoke calmly, but he was barely suppressing his painful feelings. As the captain of 'Shimart's Army,' he was heavily burdened by the guilt of putting his comrades in danger as soon as he woke up.
In terms of numbers, it was only two, but the death of Makiram and Manta was 40% of the remaining forces.
"Since they became the catalyst for the return spell, the two brothers couldn't even have the honor of becoming immortal soldiers."

In its heyday, the enemy clan operated a battalion called the Immortal Army, which weaponized the bodies of the fallen. As Ozen said, since they couldn't retrieve the bodies of Makiram and Manta, they couldn't become the Immortal Army.

"......That's a problem, but I'm worried about the bracelets that the two brothers had, brother Shimart. Especially Jin Runkandel deliberately cut off brother Makiram's arm. He was after the bracelet. It would be good if they were completely destroyed when the bodies of our brothers burned, but there is a high chance that it won't happen."

"Even if the bracelet remains damaged, it can't be analyzed with inferior human technology! Brother Andollin. Indeed, his power was formidable, but no trace of any technology was found around him. There were no portable void-space storages, let alone any flying vessels."

"Brother Ozhen, there was no void-space storage, but they didn't have many possessions. Also, the ground we fought on seemed deserted, far from any city. They must have used teleportation, or something similar, to find Ameris."
"That means, Brother Shimate, they might have the technological capability to analyze the bracelets..."

"It's better to assume so. Of course, even our technologists, who acquired the knowledge of the sun god to create them, won't be able to analyze them quickly. And even if they finish the analysis, replicating and using the bracelet is another problem."
To use the bracelet, one fundamentally needed the light heart of the Chosen and a sturdy body capable of enduring the overload.
"We are now in a completely different world than before we were sealed. We need to consider that everyone, including humans and other mortals, is in a competitive state with us."
Shimate was a person with excellent judgment and potential. That's why, despite being 'a one without a clan', he was the fastest to become a first-class fighting king in the history of the Chosen.
Ozhen, who was furious at Shimate's attitude, gradually calmed down. Andollin's grief-stricken eyes also regained their determination.
Both were grateful that among the unsealed Chosen, Shimate was included. If he was there, and if the sealed Chosen didn't completely vanish and remained...
It seemed perfectly possible to once again witness a world stained in red.
Slowly, Shimate looked around. He could see the dark landscape of the return room of the Patlock Castle.
Despite clearly being neglected for such a long time, the return room did not feel old at all. There were no large or small cracks on the stones worn by time, nor any dust accumulated.
With the lights turned on, and the Chosen traversing this place once again, it would become the same scene as before the seal.
"Fortunately, it seems the owner of the Patlock Castle, the Grand Fighting King Rakiman Hog, is still alive."

As Shimate said, the castle being intact was only possible because its owner was alive. The castles of the Chosen were organic entities connected to their respective owners, who were Grand Fighting Kings.
"Ah, that's right... the castle is intact!"
"Let's go to the master's room."
As Shimate touched a right-angled panel attached to the wall of the return room with his bracelet, a faint red light blinked, and the sound of an elevator operating was heard.
As they descended on the elevator, they immediately arrived at the central hall of the Patlock Castle. And they could see the figures of their brethren floating like red stars on the high ceiling.
There seemed to be over a hundred brethren. Most were ordinary warriors, but occasionally second or third-class fighting kings were visible.
At this sight, even Shimate revealed a moment of overwhelming emotion. They were the brethren who had defended the Patlock Castle until the end, before the seal.
Upon opening the door to the lord's chamber, they saw the sealed Great Fighter, Rakiman Hog.
"Andollin brother."
"Yes, Shimat brother."
"I am going to unseal Brother Rakiman now. However, it might be difficult to awaken Rakiman's Photon Heart before we fully recover."
"We need to create a means for us to recover first. Check if the spatial transportation devices leading to the ground within the castle are operational."
"Yes!"
Andollin went out of the lord's chamber and checked the spatial transportation devices.
"Fortunately, one out of five is working!"

"Then, from now on, both brothers will start ground operations. Go out and find nutrients and assess the current situation. Especially, dig thoroughly for information about Jin Runcandel and his forces."
"Understood, Brother Shimat. Should we gather the return catalyst as we go?"
Upon Andollin's question, Shimat nodded with a heavy gaze.
"....If possible, yes, but always take a sealed brother's Photon Heart when going to the ground."
Shimat deemed it necessary for Andollin and Ogen, who will be operating on the ground, to have a means of escape at any time.
Currently, it was not easy to always secure the 'catalyst's energy' needed for the return spell. To use an ordinary human as a catalyst, at least a hundred were needed.

Not only humans but also dragons, demons, or any living creature could be a catalyst, but the current Crimson Tribe hadn't recovered their former power. They could potentially die if they tried to use just anyone as a catalyst as they did before the seal.

"It's a painful thing. But there's no other way. The moment one of our brothers dies, our Crimson Tribe's revival becomes that much more precarious. The brothers who will be the catalyst for the return spell.... should be selected based on combat power."

If there was any consolation for the three of them, it was that the brothers who would now serve as catalysts could potentially become the immortal army in the future. The greatest honor for the Crimson Tribe's warriors was to become part of the immortal army.
"When should we start our operations?"
"Immediately, from now. Return once every ten days, or immediately if there are matters that need to be reported immediately."
"We will try to return without using the brothers' Photon Hearts as much as possible."
Andollin and Ogen placed their hands on their chests and saluted Shimat. It was like old times, reporting the start of their mission to their superior.
The two went out to the central hall, extracted the Photon Hearts from two ordinary soldiers, and swallowed their tears.
Shimat sat in front of Rakiman, illuminating the Photon Heart with a red glow. The faint red energy radiating from the Photon Heart flowed into Rakiman.
'The crimson sky will be restored, and our Sun God will be resurrected.'
That was how Shimat was shaking off his painful feelings with resolve.
Meanwhile, Jin and his companions had returned to Tikang Palace with Ameris' avatar.

They were worried about the sudden appearance of the Crimson Tribe and the emerging presence of the Sun God's followers in the current world. However, Ameris had the attitude that everything had already happened, and it just needed to be resolved well.
She demonstrated her adaptability, quickly blending into the group of companions. For her, who had always been bound by fate, this lifestyle was a real godsend.

[I have lost too many memories, so I had forgotten about their seal. And the return spell... It reminded me when I saw it directly. The fact that the return spell is perfectly executed means their base is still intact.]
"Still intact? Goodness, we're in trouble. They belong to the same race as your brother, after all... Aren't they immensely powerful?"
[Yes, Jet. Shimat couldn't fight properly this time due to the aftereffects of the seal, but he originally had a combat power even greater than Balkas. The others were probably around Rata's level.]
"How many of them are there?"

[If only one of their fortresses is left, less than a thousand. If there are other fortresses... I would guess around one to ten thousand per fortress. As far as I know, there are a total of five fortresses: Yong, Hon, Kam, Hog, and Toon, each governed by the Great Fighters of their respective tribes.]
Jet kept making a fuss, holding his forehead. Jin felt the pressure guessing their size and combat power.
[And above the Great Fighters is the God of War. His survival is the biggest issue. His name... I can't remember it. Like Shimat, the God of War of the Crimson Tribe also had no tribe.]
"Anyway, it seems that Shimat and his party will start unsealing the Crimson Tribe from now on."
[Yes, Jin. They've probably already started. My seal put their Photon Hearts to sleep. If those Photon Hearts receive enough energy, they can awaken again.]
It wasn't clear why Ameris had only sealed them. However, it was easy to infer that the Crimson Tribe was so strong at the time that she had no other choice.
[They will need time too. And they will definitely start activities on the ground. They will need to hunt to recover their power. They also need to gather information about the ground.]
"Hunting..."

[In my opinion, they won't attack our Barmel Alliance for now. They've already been severely hit by you, so they'll be careful. What we can hope for is that they regain their strength by attacking our enemies, including Ziepl. And we need to trace their activities to find their base.]
